overview_description.description: WEDDnGO is the biggest marketplace app in Egypt that specializes in weddings and any related details, by connecting the users with a wide range of wedding services providers, from Dress Designers & ateliers, Makeup Artists, Beauty Centers, Travel Agencies, Wedding Venues, Cosmetic Doctors, Photographers, and Wedding Car Renters. Also, you can book all these services in installments for the first time in Egypt.
